questions.stem: What is the difference between a saturated and an unsaturated fatty acid?

options.text: Saturated fatty acids have no carbon-carbon double bonds while unsaturated ones have one or more
Unsaturated fatty acids contain only single bonds between carbon atoms
Saturated fatty acids are found only in plants
Saturated fatty acids are shorter than unsaturated ones

questions.explanation: Saturated fatty acids have no carbon-carbon double bonds (all bonds are single), making them straight. Unsaturated fatty acids have one or more double bonds, causing kinks in the chain.
